name: @crazyglegit/support-widget
description: Prebuilt isolated customer widget for Support Kit

scripts.size: pnpm build && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),z=require('node:zlib'),files=fs.readdirSync('dist').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')&&!f.includes('.test.')),b=Buffer.concat(files.map(f=>fs.readFileSync('dist/'+f)));console.log(JSON.stringify({scope:'emitted widget modules; dependencies external',files,bytes:b.length,gzipBytes:z.gzipSync(b).length}))"
